instruction: I want to help improve Ubuntu by automatically sending error reports. Can you enable automatic problem reporting?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic problem reporting (showing apport crashes). Config sets show-apport-crashes to false, instruction asks to enable it. The evaluator checks if the setting is true. Uses existing exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks if automatic problem reporting is enabled by reading gsettings value
Getter logic is correct: executes 'gsettings get com.ubuntu.update-notifier show-apport-crashes' to extract the current setting state
Metric comparison is appropriate: uses exact_match to compare the result with expected value 'true\n'
Expected value is semantically correct: 'true\n' matches the actual output format from gsettings command (includes newline)
Data flow is sound: getter extracts the right state → metric compares correctly → expected value is accurate
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement specified in the instruction
Metric parameter handling is correct: exact_match function properly accesses rules['expected'] for type='rule' pattern
